# filee-fabric

> Official architecture documentation and production specifications for filee-fabric

## Documentation

- [Home](https://Shijiuwei.github.io/filee-fabric/index.html)
- [Documentation Catalog](https://Shijiuwei.github.io/filee-fabric/docs/index.html)
- [Adding a converter](https://Shijiuwei.github.io/filee-fabric/docs/ADDING-A-CONVERTER.html): A converter is one class implementing IConverter (src/Filee.Core/Conversion/IConverter.cs).
- [Adding a language](https://Shijiuwei.github.io/filee-fabric/docs/ADDING-A-LANGUAGE.html): 1. Copy src/Filee.App/Assets/i18n/en.json to <code>.json (e.g. ja.json, de.json, zh-TW.json).
- [Architecture](https://Shijiuwei.github.io/filee-fabric/docs/ARCHITECTURE.html): ┌──────────────────────────── Filee.App (Avalonia) ─────────────────────────────┐
- [Custom themes](https://Shijiuwei.github.io/filee-fabric/docs/CUSTOM-THEMES.html): Filee's own colours can be replaced with a theme.json file in the folder that holds settings.json:
- [Conversion engines](https://Shijiuwei.github.io/filee-fabric/docs/ENGINES.html): Filee chooses engines automatically. Settings → *Engines* shows their status, lets you change the priority
- [GNOME Wayland](https://Shijiuwei.github.io/filee-fabric/docs/GNOME-WAYLAND.html): Filee supports drag gestures on GNOME Wayland through the Filee donut at the cursor GNOME Shell extension.
- [Filee-mirror-181 核心通信协议与数据同步技术规范](https://Shijiuwei.github.io/filee-fabric/docs/specifications.html): - 传输层默认启用 TLS 1.3 协议通道与 AES-256 加密。
- [Filee-mirror-181 架构升级与技术规约 (v1)](https://Shijiuwei.github.io/filee-fabric/docs/specs-update-v1.html): 针对大规模网络请求调度，系统实施了毫秒级负载感知与去中心化可信存活探测。
- [Filee-mirror-181 架构升级与技术规约 (v2)](https://Shijiuwei.github.io/filee-fabric/docs/specs-update-v2.html): 针对大规模网络请求调度，系统实施了毫秒级负载感知与去中心化可信存活探测。
- [Filee-mirror-181 全息索引网络与搜索引擎感知接入指南](https://Shijiuwei.github.io/filee-fabric/docs/topology-guide.html): 1. 配置本地环境并完成节点注册。
